title: papaver somniferum convar. album
intro: Papaver somniferum convar. album, commonly known as the white opium poppy, is a plant species in the poppy family that produces white latex containing opium, a mixture of alkaloids. The health benefits of Papaver somniferum convar. album include its use as a sedative and analgesic, which can help alleviate pain and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as thebaine, codeine, and morphine, and flavonoids like papaverine and reticuline. These constituents contribute to the plant's sedative, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
